faqs.q: Is Malta too small for SEO to matter?
faqs.a: The opposite. Small markets mean thin competition, so good SEO wins faster. And on an island where reputation is everything, dominating search is dominating the conversation.

faqs.q: Should my site be in Maltese or English?
faqs.a: Both, for different audiences. English for tourists, expats and iGaming; Maltese for local trust and everyday consumer searches. Proper hreflang keeps them from competing.

faqs.q: How do reviews affect my rankings in Malta?
faqs.a: Enormously. In a small market, review quantity, recency and detail are among the strongest ranking and conversion signals. A systematic review process is non-negotiable here.

faqs.q: When should a tourism business start SEO?
faqs.a: In winter. Summer tourism pages need months to rank, so building starts in the off-season. Starting in May for a July season leaves most of the opportunity on the table.
